appName.description: Full product name shown in the Chrome Web Store listing and on the extension card.

appShortName.description: Short name used where space is constrained (toolbar tooltip, some browser UIs).

appDescription.message: Privacy-first AI form filler. Turn any PDF, DOCX, XLSX, or Markdown into a filled web form, with review before fill. Bring your own AI key, or run fully on-device. No servers, no telemetry, no account.
appDescription.description: Chrome Web Store description. Must stay under 132 characters for the short listing and ideally under 200 overall.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip on the toolbar action button.

errorBoundary.message: The panel encountered a problem. Close and reopen it to start a fresh session. Inspect your form before retrying.

needsExtension.message: This UI needs extension APIs. Build the project, load dist/ unpacked in Chrome or Edge, and click the extension toolbar icon.

introBody.message: Extract locally, review with AI, then fill on your terms.

configureProviderHint.message: Configure a provider to start. Document text extraction runs locally in this browser; the provider is contacted only after you approve sending the extracted text and field metadata.

progressCanceling.message: Canceling remaining work. Already filled fields may remain; inspect the results.

footerNote.message: Document parsing stays local. AI suggestions send extracted text and field metadata to your chosen provider after consent. Closing this panel may cancel work; requests are never resumed automatically.

errActiveTabChanged.message: The active tab changed. Click the toolbar icon on the intended page, then scan and review again.

errDocumentRouteChanged.message: The document or route changed. Scan and review again.

errInspectPartial.message: $MESSAGE$ Inspect the page for partial changes before rescanning.

errNoFields.message: No supported fields were found on this page.

errHostPermissionMissing.message: Host permission is missing. Enable the provider again.

errAddOneDocument.message: Add one document at a time; parsed documents stay in the list below.

dropZoneBody.message: Drop documents here, or choose a file. Add as many as you need.

dropZoneFormats.message: PDF · Word (.docx) · Excel (.xlsx/.xls) · Markdown (.md) · Text (.txt) · 10 MiB each

docMeta.message: $KIND$ · $PAGES$ $UNITS$ · $CHARS$ characters · Check reading order and source accuracy.

consentBuiltin.message: Generating suggestions is handled by your browser's **on-device model**. Extracted document text and selected form metadata never leave this device. Original files and existing field values are not used.

consentLocal.message: Generating suggestions sends extracted document text and selected form metadata to **$PROVIDER$** on this computer. Nothing is sent to the cloud. Original files and existing field values are not used.

consentCloud.message: Generating suggestions sends extracted document text and selected form metadata to **$PROVIDER$**, a cloud provider. Original files and existing field values are not sent.

consentAccuracyBuiltin.message: On-device accuracy is experimental; every suggestion still needs your review.

consentAccuracyLocal.message: Local model accuracy varies; every suggestion still needs your review.

consentAccuracyCloud.message: Your provider's retention policy and API charges apply.

consentRequestsNote.message: One request plus at most one validation-repair request may be made. No automatic provider fallback.

enableProviderToContinue.message: Enable a provider above to continue.

reviewHint.message: Evidence shows where text came from, not that the match is correct. Select only the values you want to fill.

noAssignments.message: No supported, evidence-backed assignments were returned. The form has not been changed.

fillNotice.message: Filling can trigger the site's validation, autosave, or network requests. This extension never clicks Submit. Undo cannot reverse server-side effects.

resultsHint.message: Verified on this page, not confirmed by the server. Rescan before another fill.

undoHint.message: Undo preserves later edits and cannot reverse autosave or other page-side effects. Resetting or rescanning clears undo.

psStatusDefault.message: Configure a provider to generate suggestions.

psBuiltinUnavailableSaved.message: The saved on-device provider is not available in this browser right now. Choose another provider.

psBuiltinRestored.message: On-device provider restored. Suggestions stay on this device.

psCustomEndpointMissing.message: The saved custom endpoint is missing. Configure it again.

psLocalRestored.message: Local provider restored. Requests stay on this machine.

psKeyRestored.message: Stored key restored. Provider/model live verification is not included.

psRestoreFailed.message: Settings could not be restored. Configure the provider again.

psUnsaved.message: Unsaved changes. Enable this provider before generating suggestions.

psBuiltinUnavailable.message: The on-device model is not available in this browser right now. Choose another provider.

psPermissionDeclined.message: Host permission was declined. No document was sent.

psBuiltinVerified.message: On-device provider verified and enabled. Text never leaves this device; on-device accuracy is experimental.

psLocalVerified.message: Local provider verified and enabled. Requests stay on this machine or network; nothing is sent to the cloud.

psCloudVerified.message: Provider verified and enabled. The key works; model compatibility for filling is not guaranteed.

psKeyRemoved.message: Stored key removed. Host permission can also be revoked below.

psKeyRemoveFailed.message: Could not remove the key. Try again.

psKeySavedTitle.message: An API key is saved for this provider

psBuiltinReady.message: The browser on-device model is ready. No API key, no network request; extracted text never leaves this device. On-device accuracy is experimental.

psBuiltinDownload.message: The browser will download its on-device model on first use; download progress appears during generation. No API key and no network request afterwards.

psModelPlaceholderLocal.message: Model name loaded on your local server

psModelPlaceholderCloud.message: Model ID from your provider account

psKeyPlaceholderLocal.message: Leave blank if your local server needs no key

psKeyPlaceholderCloud.message: Encrypted and saved on this device

psNoticeCloud.message: ☁️ **Data notice:** Help Me Fill stores no data, but generating suggestions **sends your extracted document text and field metadata to $PROVIDER$**. Nothing is sent until you review and approve it on the next step.

psNoticeLocal.message: 🏠 **Setup required:** install and start [$NAME$]($URL$) on this computer, then load a model (for example `$MODEL$`). Saving runs a quick local check that the server is reachable. Requests stay on this machine — nothing is sent to the cloud.

psNoticeCustom.message: 🏠 **Setup required:** start your local OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, llamafile, vLLM…) and enter its `/v1/chat/completions` address above. Allowed hosts over `http://`: `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, and private LAN ranges (`192.168.x.x`, `10.x.x.x`, `172.16–31.x.x`). Saving runs a quick check that the server is reachable. Requests stay on your machine or local network — nothing is sent to the cloud.

psKeyHint.message: API keys are encrypted with AES-GCM and stored only on this device — not a hardware-backed vault, and never sent anywhere except your chosen provider. Cloud provider accounts determine model availability and charges. Local and on-device providers run entirely on this computer. No backend or subscription is included.

errTargetChanged.message: The target tab or page changed. Scan and review again.

errConnectionLost.message: The page connection was lost. Click the toolbar icon on the form page, then scan again.

errInvalidResponse.message: The page returned an invalid response.

errOpenFormPage.message: Open an HTTP(S) form page and click the help-me-fill toolbar icon to grant access.

errStorePage.message: Browser extension stores cannot be filled. Open a normal form page.

errAccessDenied.message: Page access was denied. Click the extension toolbar icon on this tab, then scan again. Restricted pages are not supported.

errNoDocumentId.message: The browser did not provide a document identity. Update the browser and try again.

errConnectionClosed.message: The page connection closed. Scan again.

errCanceled.message: Canceled. No new request was started.

errGeneric.message: The operation could not complete. Reset the session and try again.

fillNeedsApproval.message: Overwriting an existing value requires explicit approval.

fillCanceledOrInactive.message: The operation was canceled or the target tab is no longer active.

fillChangedOnFocus.message: The target changed on focus. Remaining fields were not filled.

fillVerified.message: Value and native validity persisted through verification.

fillReverted.message: The page changed, rejected, or replaced this value. Inspect it manually.

fillStopped.message: Stopped after a target change or execution failure.

undoNotRetained.message: The page did not retain the previous value.

ctrlValueNotOption.message: The value is not one of the field options.

ctrlTooShort.message: Value is shorter than the field minimum.

ctrlNormalize.message: The browser would normalize this value. Edit it before filling.

ctrlConstraint.message: Value does not satisfy the field type, pattern, or required constraint.

scanFormChanged.message: The form changed after scanning. Scan and review again.

scanFormStructureChanged.message: The form structure changed. Scan and review again.

idxBusy.message: Another operation is still running. Wait for it to finish.

idxPanelDisconnected.message: The review panel is no longer connected. Nothing was filled.

parseUnsupportedType.message: Choose a PDF, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx/.xls), Markdown (.md), or plain text (.txt) file. Legacy .doc and image-only scans are not supported.

parseTooLarge.message: Documents must be 10 MiB or smaller. Choose a smaller file.

pdfInvalidType.message: Choose a valid PDF file. Word, Excel, Markdown, and text files are routed to their own parsers; OCR is not supported.

pdfTooLarge.message: PDFs must be 10 MiB or smaller. Choose a smaller document.

pdfBadHeader.message: This file does not contain a valid PDF header.

pdfPassword.message: Password-protected PDFs are not supported. Choose an unprotected document.

pdfTooManyPages.message: PDFs may contain at most 20 pages. Choose a shorter document; nothing was truncated.

pdfTooMuchText.message: Extracted text exceeds 24,000 characters. Choose a shorter PDF; nothing was truncated.

xlsxUnreadable.message: This spreadsheet could not be read. Re-export it as .xlsx and try again.

xlsxNoSheets.message: This workbook has no visible sheets.

textNoText.message: No extractable text was found. Scanned or image-only documents require OCR, which is not included yet.

textTooMuch.message: Extracted text exceeds 24,000 characters. Choose a shorter document; nothing was truncated.

provBuiltinNoHttpResponse.message: The on-device provider does not use HTTP responses.
